samples.question: The image shows one closed black loop drawn on a white background, and two small colored dots: one red and one blue. A closed loop splits the plane into two sides: its inside (the white pocket the loop surrounds) and its outside (the rest of the white background). The two dots are on OPPOSITE sides of the loop exactly when one of them lies inside the loop and the other lies outside it. Are the red dot and the blue dot on opposite sides of the closed black loop? Answer with exactly yes or no.
